newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Airbus says SIA unit confirms purchase of aircraft.
newsitem.headline: Airbus says SIA unit confirms purchase of aircraft.

text.p: Airbus Industrie said on Tuesday Singapore Aircraft Leasing Enterprise (SALE) had signed a contract for the purchase of up to 24 new generation single aisle aircraft, confirming a memorandum of understanding signed in June.
Airbus Industrie said in a statement the contract covered firm orders for eight A320s and four A321s, plus options for 12 aircraft of any type from the A320 family.
The aircraft are scheduled for delivery from January 1998. The statement added no decision had been made on the choice of engines. No details of costs were given.
SALE is jointly owned by Singapore Airlines Ltd (SIA) and U.S. leasing company Boullioun Aviation Services Inc, a subsidiary of The Sumitomo Trust and Banking Co Ltd.
